summary: Metagroups group other groups using children. A group can be in several metagroups; parent group_vars apply to children but child values override, so prefer one parent for predictable inheritance.
questions: How do I make a group of groups in inventory?
Can a group belong to more than one parent group?
Do child groups inherit parent group variables?
Which wins, parent or child group_vars?

answer_card.title: Use metagroups in inventory
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
metagroupname:
  children:
    network:
    webservers:
```
- A group can sit under several metagroups (for example `network` under both `datacenter` and `ops`).
- Parent `group_vars` apply to hosts in child groups; a child group's values override the parent's.
- For predictable inheritance, give each group only one parent.
